description.value:
A military-grade medi-gel formula incorporating advanced cellular scaffolding agents, capable of repairing severe trauma in seconds.

Whenever you apply Medi-Gel to a creature (including yourself), it restores [[/r 70[healing]]] Hit Points instead of the base 25. This bonus is determined by the character applying the medi-gel, not the recipient. As normal, healing cannot exceed the target's maximum HP, and excess is lost.

This is a tiered upgrade. It replaces Medi-Gel Upgrade II — a character benefits only from their single highest Medi-Gel Upgrade.
